title: Encoding a list of words
statement: For a list $L$ of Boolean words, its encoding is the concatenation, in order, of the pair encodings of each word in $L$ with the empty word.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the pair encoding, so its precise convention cannot be specified.
